question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.9.**
solution:
​The correct answer is "**are developed**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The **theme **of the passage is the** significance of childhood**. The right nurturing in childhood will lead to a life of greatness and success.
 
• In the given sentence, since we are talking about childhood we need to use the verb in the **past participle **form with an **auxiliary verb**.
 
• We need to use **are **before the verb for the subject-verb agreement.
 
• So we need to use '**are developed**'
 
 
• **Example**: *The new self-driving cars **are developed __**as per safety protocols.*
 
 

**T****he **complete passage is:- *The child is the father of man. Childhood is a **(1) __promise__**__ __of what one is going to be when one **(2)__attains__**__ __maturity. The natural instincts of a man are **(3)__determined__**__ __in his childhood. Time modifies them but cannot **(4)__efface__**__ __them. History contains numerous examples of great men who gave **(5)__indications__**__ __of their future when they were children. A child’s mind is **(6)****__impressionable____ __and flexible. The mould he receives before his clay **(7)__hardens__** becomes his permanent mark. The values and standards of **(8)__conduct__**__ __which will determine his life as a man **(9)__are developed__**__ __in childhood itself. There may be certain **(10)__exceptions__**__ __of course. A bright morning may end in a storm!*
